name: Two-column process detail
purpose: To explain a specific module or process step by splitting the approach and the sources into two distinct lists.
use_when: When you need to present a 'how-to' (Vorgehen) alongside the 'where from' (Recherchequellen) for a specific project phase.
avoid_when: When you have a single long list of items or need to present complex data charts.
notes: The layout features a central circular image placeholder that overlaps the two text columns; ensure text does not wrap into the image area.

imagery.depicts: a person wearing a VR headset seen through a magnifying glass
